**Wrote the 4.2.0 section** into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 127 PRs, 18 user-facing.

Four breaking changes hide under `refactor` and `fix` labels. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. The latency histogram units changed. The v1 export route is gone.

One real feature. Webhook retries with exponential backoff.

Two calls for you:

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| Perf wins | Four of them. Dropped, since we only use three headings. |
| Node version | Five `docs: note the minimum node version` commits, no `engines` bump. Check `package.json`. |
